scope: Linux/POSIX process APIs, x86-64 syscall register ABI, CSAPP exception teaching taxonomy.

claims.claim: fork creates a new child process with its own PID, using COW for memory where possible.
claims.notes: Avoid claiming fork is independent of page table size.

claims.claim: execve replaces current process image and does not return on success.
claims.locator: DESCRIPTION and Effect on process attributes
claims.notes: PID preserved; FD_CLOEXEC may close descriptors.

claims.claim: waitpid retrieves child exit state and reaps a zombie; adoption can use subreapers.
claims.notes: Orphans and zombies are separate concepts.

claims.claim: Linux x86-64 system call arguments and error handling differ from C ABI wrappers.
claims.notes: Raw error return is not glibc wrapper result.

claims.claim: Interrupt/trap/fault/abort taxonomy is an instructional CPU exception model.
claims.notes: Hardware abort is distinct from C assert/abort function.

claims.claim: Child successfully execs /bin/true, parent prints child exit=0 after waitpid.
claims.notes: CI script verifies; expected on GNU/Linux with /bin/true.
